announcements.headline: BATM wins additional $4.0m cybersecurity order
announcements.insight: BATM wins additional $4.0m cybersecurity order. This follows a $1.0m order in September and a tactical encryption platform order in August.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The general meeting results confirm shareholder approval for ongoing corporate governance matters. This follows recent contract wins but does not indicate new strategic direction.

announcements.headline: New $1.0m order from leading US Broadband Provider
announcements.insight: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd. secured a new order from its leading US Broadband Provider, following earlier contract and extension announcements.

announcements.headline: Notice of GM and Update on Transaction
First Order for Tactical Encryption Platform
announcements.insight: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd. secured its first tactical encryption platform order, following earlier broadband contracts in June and July 2026.

announcements.headline: Contract extension with top US broadband operator
announcements.insight: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd. secured a contract extension with its leading US Broadband Provider, following the initial new contract announced in June 2026.

announcements.headline: New contract with leading US Broadband Provider
announcements.insight: BATM Advanced Communications Ltd secured a new contract with a leading US Broadband Provider. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent details regarding revenue impact and execution progress.
